categories.main_business_segments: Yulon Motor's primary business segments include manufacturing and sales of various automobiles and related components, automotive repair and maintenance services, automotive parts sales, and vehicle assembly services. The company also engages in telecommunications equipment wholesale and retail, general import-export trade, real estate development and leasing, power generation, and energy technology services. The automotive segment accounts for over 92% of its revenue, focusing on brands such as Nissan, Infiniti, and its own Luxgen brand.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced automotive manufacturing technologies including engine assembly, stamping, welding, painting, and vehicle assembly. It integrates smart manufacturing techniques such as automation, big data for quality management, and laser welding technology. Yulon also develops electric vehicles and energy storage systems, leveraging lithium-ion battery technology and collaborating on open platform EV solutions with partners like Foxconn. It maintains ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications for environmental and occupational safety management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yulon primarily serves the Taiwanese automotive market with passenger cars and SUVs under Nissan, Infiniti, and Luxgen brands. It also targets overseas markets through exports and joint ventures. Key customers include automotive dealers, fleet operators, and end consumers seeking passenger and leisure vehicles. The company additionally serves telecommunications and energy sectors through its related business units and subsidiaries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with manufacturing facilities located in Miaoli County and sales concentrated in the domestic market. It has significant overseas investments and subsidiaries in China, the Philippines, Hong Kong, and other regions, supporting automotive manufacturing, sales, and energy businesses. Yulon also engages in regional economic cooperation and cross-strait automotive industry collaboration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yulon Motor operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive supply chain, focusing on vehicle assembly, manufacturing of automotive components, and sales. It maintains long-term supply contracts with upstream suppliers such as Nissan and other parts manufacturers. The company also extends into downstream services including vehicle sales, maintenance, and leasing through its subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in electric vehicle development, energy storage systems, and smart manufacturing. It pursues open platform strategies and resource sharing to enhance multi-brand manufacturing capabilities. R&D priorities include EV powertrain validation, battery assembly, laser welding, and energy storage system production. Yulon actively invests in sustainability initiatives, digital transformation, and integration of AI and big data to improve product quality and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Yulon generates revenue primarily through the sale of automobiles and automotive components, including contract manufacturing and assembly services for partner brands. Additional revenue streams include leasing and rental services, telecommunications equipment sales, energy technology services, and real estate leasing. The company also earns income from investments and subsidiaries engaged in automotive financing and insurance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yulon competes with both domestic and international automotive manufacturers in Taiwan, including import brands and local producers. It positions itself as a leading Taiwanese automotive manufacturer with strong multi-brand capabilities, combining joint venture partnerships (notably with Nissan) and its own Luxgen brand. The company leverages its manufacturing expertise, flexible production, and innovation in EVs to maintain competitiveness against rising import penetration and evolving market demands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported fiscal year, Yulon achieved consolidated revenues of approximately NT$85.8 billion with a net profit of around NT$6.9 billion. The company experienced a 4.45% increase in revenue compared to the prior year, despite challenges in the overall Taiwanese automotive market. It maintains substantial assets totaling over NT$377 billion and equity exceeding NT$94 billion. The company shows steady growth with ongoing investments in R&D and capital expenditures to support strategic transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yulon emphasizes customer satisfaction, value creation, and innovation as core to its competitive advantage. It differentiates through advanced automotive technologies, including semi-autonomous driving features, long-range electric vehicles with extensive charging infrastructure, and flexible multi-brand manufacturing. The company integrates sustainability into its operations, offering green products and services while maintaining high-quality standards and comprehensive after-sales support. Its open platform and resource-sharing approach enable cost efficiency and rapid adaptation to market trends.
